// Package diagnosticbinding owns the closed rollout configuration used by the
// diagnostic bootstrap route. It deliberately has no learner, Course-content,
// Student, Teacher, or placement behavior.
package diagnosticbinding

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

const (
	ProvisionSchema          = "planner-diagnostic-bootstrap-binding-provision.v1"
	CanonicalGoal            = "first-job"
	CanonicalDirection       = "backend"
	CanonicalRevision  int64 = 1
)

// Store is the narrow append-only persistence capability required by the
// rollout provisioner. Its implementation serializes the latest-row lookup
// with the subsequent insert.
type Store interface {
	ProvisionDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding, bool, error)
}

type Result struct {
	Status  string
	Binding domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding
}

// CanonicalBinding builds the only binding this V2 fixture is permitted to
// create. The caller supplies the Course identity and immutable creation time;
// Planner calculates the digest instead of accepting a caller-supplied hash.
func CanonicalBinding(courseID string, createdAt time.Time) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding, error) {
	binding := domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{
		GoalCode:        CanonicalGoal,
		DirectionCode:   CanonicalDirection,
		CourseID:        courseID,
		BindingRevision: CanonicalRevision,
		PolicyVersion:   domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1,
		Active:          true,
		CreatedAt:       createdAt,
	}
	digest, err := domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBindingDigest(binding)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, err
	}
	binding.BindingDigest = digest
	return domain.NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(binding)
}

func Provision(ctx context.Context, store Store, courseID string, createdAt time.Time) (Result, error) {
	binding, err := CanonicalBinding(courseID, createdAt)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	stored, created, err := store.ProvisionDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(ctx, binding)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if stored != binding {
		return Result{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	status := "already_present"
	if created {
		status = "created"
	}
	return Result{Status: status, Binding: stored}, nil
}
